versos.e: Succeeds David to the throne of Israel 1Ki 1:11-48; 2:12; 1Ch 23:1; 28; Ec 1:12
Marries one of Pharaoh’ s daughters 1Ki 3:1
His prayer for wisdom, and his vision 1Ki 3:5-14; 2Ch 1:7-12
Justice of, illustrated in his judgment of the two prostitutes 1Ki 3:16-28
Divides his kingdom into subsistence departments; the daily, subsistence rate for his court 1Ki 4:7-23,27,28
Builds his house, The Forest of Lebanon 1Ki 7:2-7
Builds another house for Pharaoh’ s daughter 1Ki 7:8-12; 9:24; 2Ch 8:11; Ec 2:4
Covenant renewed in a vision after the dedication of the temple 1Ki 9:1-9; 2Ch 7:12-22
Cedes some inferior cities to Hiram 1Ki 9:10-13; 2Ch 8:2
Builds Millo (a stronghold), the wall around Jerusalem, the cities of Hazor, Megiddo, Gezer, Beth-horon, Baalath, Tadmor, store cities, and cities for chariots, and for cavalry 1Ki 9:15-19; 2Ch 9:25
Is visited by the Queen of Sheba 1Ki 10:1-13; 2Ch 9:1-12
The splendor of his court 1Ki 10:5-9,12; 2Ch 9:3-8; Ec 2:9; Mt 6:29; Lu 12:27
Musicians and musical instruments of his court 1Ki 10:12; 2Ch 9:11; Ec 2:8
Has seven-hundred wives and three-hundred concubines 1Ki 11:3; with De 17:17
Renews the courses of the priests and Levites, and the forms of service according to the commandment of Moses and the regulations of David 2Ch 8:12-16; 35:4; Ne 12:45
Named Jedidiah, by Nathan the prophet 2Sa 12:24,25
Plants vineyards and orchards of all kinds of fruit trees; makes pools Ec 2:4-6
